page:
OpenAPI patterns and advanced usage. Elysia has first-class OpenAPI support and follows spec by default. Install plugin: `bun add @elysia/openapi`. Register: .use(openapi()). Access at /openapi - Scalar UI with generated docs from server. Or access raw spec at /openapi/json.
Questions: How do you generate OpenAPI docs? Where are docs available? How do you access raw spec?

sections.manifest:
OpenAPI from types generation. Optional but recommended. Two approaches: runtime schema (default) or TypeScript types (Type Gen via fromTypes). Specify root file exporting Elysia instance. Import generator: `openapi({ references: fromTypes() })`. File path from project root provided to generator. Elysia reads type of exported instance to generate documentation. Co-exists with runtime schema - runtime takes precedence.
Questions: How do you generate from types? What is co-existence? Which takes precedence?

Production environment Type Gen. Pre-generate .d.ts declaration file for type access. Use in openapi config: `fromTypes(process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'dist/index.d.ts' : 'src/index.ts')`. Provides type declaration for bundled/executable Elysia.
Questions: How do you handle Type Gen in production? What file format is needed?

Explicit types caveat for Type Gen. Works best with implicit types. Explicit types may cause generator resolution failure. Solution: use Prettify helper to inline type: `type Prettify<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] } & {}`. Apply to function return type: `function getUser(): Prettify<User>`. Inlines type for proper generation.
Questions: What explicit types issue? How do you fix it? What is Prettify?

Root path configuration for Type Gen. Unreliable to guess project root, especially monorepo. Provide path explicitly in fromTypes options: `fromTypes('src/index.ts', { projectRoot: path.join('..', import.meta.dir) })`. Ensures generator runs correctly.
Questions: Why specify root path? How do you set it?

Custom tsconfig.json handling for Type Gen. Multiple tsconfig.json files require specifying correct file for type generation. Configure in fromTypes options: `fromTypes('src/index.ts', { tsconfigPath: 'tsconfig.dts.json' })`. Path reference from project root.
Questions: How do you specify custom tsconfig? Why needed?

Standard schema with OpenAPI mapping. Elysia uses native method from each schema to convert to OpenAPI. If schema doesn't provide native method, use mapJsonSchema: { zod: toJSONSchema }, { valibot: toJsonSchema }, { effect: JSONSchema.make }. Supports Zod, Valibot, Effect with different conversion methods.
Questions: How do you map schemas? What schemas are supported? What converters are needed?

Route description via detail field. Use detail property to explicitly describe route following OpenAPI V3 spec. Example: summary, description, tags. Description properties: on field values, on body object for overall description. Auto-completion and type-safety included.
Questions: How do you describe routes? What detail properties exist?

Response headers annotation via withHeader. Wrap schema with withHeader: `withHeader(t.Literal('Hi'), { 'x-powered-by': t.Literal('Elysia') })`. Annotation only - doesn't enforce actual headers. Manually set headers: `set.headers['x-powered-by'] = 'Elysia'`.
Questions: How do you annotate headers? What must you do manually?

Hide route from Swagger page. Set detail.hide: true in route config. Example: detail: { hide: true }. Route not shown in documentation.
Questions: How do you hide routes? When should you hide?

Tags for endpoint grouping. Define available tags in openapi config: documentation.tags array with name and description. Assign endpoints to tags via detail.tags: ['App']. Separates endpoints into groups. Can use tags on instance or group via Elysia constructor or .group().
Questions: How do you group endpoints? How do you define tags? How assign tags?

Models for schema reuse. Use reference model via .model() to define reusable schemas. Reference by string name in route: response: { 200: 'User' }. Schemas listed in Components section. Simplifies documentation.
Questions: How do you use models? What is Components section?

Guard for applying documentation to routes. Use guard with detail property: .guard({ detail: { description: 'Require user logged in' } }, (app) => app.get().post()). Applies detail to all routes in guard.
Questions: How do you use guard with detail?

Change OpenAPI endpoint path via config. Default path: /openapi. Customize: .use(openapi({ path: '/v2/openapi' })). Changes endpoint URL.
Questions: How do you customize endpoint path?

Customize OpenAPI info. Set documentation.info properties: title, version. Useful for: adding title, setting API version, adding description, explaining tags. Example: { title: 'Elysia Documentation', version: '1.0.0' }.
Questions: How do you customize info? What properties matter?

Security configuration for API endpoints. Define security schemes in documentation.components.securitySchemes. Example: bearerAuth with type 'http', scheme 'bearer', bearerFormat 'JWT'. Apply to controller: detail { security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }] }. Ensures endpoints require valid JWT.
Questions: How do you define security? How apply to routes?
